name: Healing Potion
description: Steadies the hands before a fight. Increases quest success rate.

name: Supreme Healing Potion
description: Steadies the hands before a fight. Increases quest success rate more than a standard healing potion.

name: Greater Healing Potion
description: Steadies the hands before a fight. Increases quest success rate more than a standard healing potion.

name: Minor Lucky Potion
description: Coins seem to find their way into pockets.

name: Standard Lucky Potion
description: Coins seem to find their way into pockets.

name: Strength Potion
description:
A hard swing and a fair price for it.
Increases success rate, and gold drops

name: Protection Charm
description: Your knight comes home unhurt, win or lose.

name: Elixir of Fortune
description: Guarantees a favourable event on the road.

name: Restorative Draught
description: Restores a portion of Health immediately. Doesn't revive a Fallen hero -- see the Infirmary or pay to revive directly.

name: Greater Restorative Draught
description: Restores a large portion of Health immediately. Doesn't revive a Fallen hero -- see the Infirmary or pay to revive directly.

name: Guardian's Retainer
description: Equip before sending a hero out. Softens whatever this quest is about to do to them, rather than patching it up afterward.

name: Pet Treat
description: Crafted, not foraged -- a pet's own happiness bar goes up further per treat than raw scraps would give it. Fed directly from the Hatchery's Pets tab, not sent out on quests -- carries no quest effect.

name: Beckoning Charm
description: Smells like whatever Grimsby is currently burning to cover up whatever he's actually selling. Somehow, it works -- his cart tends to show up sooner after one of these gets used.
